summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX plan for Dev0 v1.6: Normal Chat Mode vs. Agent Mode Tool Isolation with downloadable ZIP artifacts (zip_create / zip_read), zero hardcoded Sub-Agents/Skills, separate Memory Graph vs. Project Code Graph tabs, Interactive Chat Plan Card with Proceed/Edit handoff, Cross-Chat Message Reader, Dual Built-in Git & Restore Point Engine (Docker real Git + Browser IndexedDB snapshots), 100% English UI translation, Sub-Agent Floating Modal with AI-Generate diagonal striped lock overlay, Live Read-Only Sub-Agent Stream Inspector & Deletion, Cron Wakeup on finish_task, and Live Streaming Thinking/Reasoning formatting fix.
